title.en: The Depression and the Second World War
title.fr: La Crise et la Seconde Guerre mondiale

text.en: After the First World War, the British Empire changed into a free association of states. It was called the British Commonwealth of Nations.
text.fr: Après la Première Guerre mondiale, l'Empire britannique s'est transformé en une libre association d'États. On l'a appelée le Commonwealth britannique des nations.

source.quote: the British Empire evolved into a free association of states known as the British Commonwealth of Nations.

verification.evidence: After the First World War, the British Empire evolved into a free association of states known as the British Commonwealth of Nations.

text.en: In 1933, 27% of workers had no job, and many businesses were ruined.
text.fr: En 1933, 27 % des travailleurs étaient sans emploi, et beaucoup d'entreprises ont été ruinées.

source.quote: Unemployment reached 27% in 1933 and many businesses were wiped out.

verification.evidence: Unemployment reached 27% in 1933 and many businesses were wiped out.

text.en: Farmers in Western Canada suffered most. Grain prices were low, and a terrible drought hit their land.
text.fr: Ce sont les agriculteurs de l'Ouest canadien qui ont le plus souffert. Le prix des céréales était bas, et une terrible sécheresse a frappé leurs terres.

source.quote: Farmers in Western Canada were hit hardest by low grain prices and a terrible drought.

verification.evidence: Farmers in Western Canada were hit hardest by low grain prices and a terrible drought.

text.en: The Bank of Canada was set up in 1934. It is a central bank. Its job is to manage the money supply and keep the financial system steady.
text.fr: La Banque du Canada a été créée en 1934. C'est une banque centrale. Son rôle est de gérer la masse monétaire et d'assurer la stabilité du système financier.

source.quote: The Bank of Canada, a central bank to manage the money supply and bring stability to the financial system, was created in 1934.

verification.evidence: The Bank of Canada, a central bank to manage the money supply and bring stability to the financial system, was created in 1934.

text.en: Fewer immigrants came, and many refugees were refused. Among them were Jews trying to escape Nazi Germany in 1939.
text.fr: Moins d'immigrants sont arrivés, et beaucoup de réfugiés ont été refoulés. Parmi eux, il y avait des Juifs qui tentaient de fuir l'Allemagne nazie en 1939.

source.quote: Immigration dropped and many refugees were turned away, including Jews trying to flee Nazi Germany in 1939.

verification.evidence: Immigration dropped and many refugees were turned away, including Jews trying to flee Nazi Germany in 1939.

text.en: The Second World War started in 1939, when Adolf Hitler, the Nazi dictator of Germany, invaded Poland.
text.fr: La Seconde Guerre mondiale a commencé en 1939, quand Adolf Hitler, le dictateur nazi de l'Allemagne, a envahi la Pologne.

source.quote: The Second World War began in 1939 when Adolf Hitler, the National Socialist (Nazi) dictator of Germany, invaded Poland

verification.evidence: The Second World War began in 1939 when Adolf Hitler, the National Socialist (Nazi) dictator of Germany, invaded Poland

text.en: Out of 11.5 million people, more than one million Canadians and Newfoundlanders served in the Second World War. Newfoundland was then a separate British territory.
text.fr: Sur une population de 11,5 millions, plus d'un million de Canadiens et de Terre-Neuviens ont servi pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Terre-Neuve était alors un territoire britannique distinct.

source.quote: More than one million Canadians and Newfoundlanders (Newfoundland was a separate British entity) served in the Second World War, out of a population of 11.5 million.

verification.evidence: More than one million Canadians and Newfoundlanders (Newfoundland was a separate British entity) served in the Second World War, out of a population of 11.5 million.

text.en: On D-Day, 15,000 Canadian soldiers attacked Juno Beach and took it from the German Army.
text.fr: Le jour J, 15 000 soldats canadiens ont attaqué la plage Juno et l'ont prise à l'armée allemande.

source.quote: 15,000 Canadian troops stormed and captured Juno Beach from the German Army

verification.evidence: In the epic invasion of Normandy in northern France on June 6, 1944, known as D-Day, 15,000 Canadian troops stormed and captured Juno Beach from the German Army

text.en: In 1944–45, the Canadian Army freed the Netherlands. It helped force Germany to surrender on May 8, 1945.
text.fr: En 1944-1945, l'armée canadienne a libéré les Pays-Bas. Elle a aidé à forcer l'Allemagne à capituler le 8 mai 1945.

source.quote: The Canadian Army liberated the Netherlands in 1944–45 and helped force the German surrender of May 8, 1945

verification.evidence: The Canadian Army liberated the Netherlands in 1944–45 and helped force the German surrender of May 8, 1945

text.en: Canadians fought bravely and suffered losses in two defeats. The first was the failed defence of Hong Kong against Imperial Japan in 1941. The second was a failed raid on Dieppe, on the coast of France, which the Nazis held, in 1942.
text.fr: Les Canadiens ont combattu avec courage et subi des pertes lors de deux défaites. La première a été la défense ratée de Hong Kong contre le Japon impérial en 1941. La seconde a été un raid raté sur Dieppe, sur la côte française, alors aux mains des nazis, en 1942.

source.quote: the unsuccessful defence of Hong Kong (1941) from attack by Imperial Japan, and in a failed raid on Nazi-controlled Dieppe on the coast of France (1942).

verification.evidence: The Canadians fought bravely and suffered losses in the unsuccessful defence of Hong Kong (1941) from attack by Imperial Japan, and in a failed raid on Nazi-controlled Dieppe on the coast of France (1942).

text.en: Under the British Commonwealth Air Training Plan, more than 130,000 Allied air crew were trained in Canada.
text.fr: Dans le cadre du Programme d'entraînement aérien du Commonwealth britannique, plus de 130 000 membres d'équipage alliés ont été formés au Canada.

source.quote: with over 130,000 Allied air crew trained in Canada under the British Commonwealth Air Training Plan.

verification.evidence: Moreover, Canada contributed more to the Allied air effort than any other Commonwealth country, with over 130,000 Allied air crew trained in Canada under the British Commonwealth Air Training Plan.

text.en: When the Second World War ended, only two countries in the world had bigger navies than Canada.
text.fr: À la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale, seuls deux pays au monde avaient une marine plus grande que celle du Canada.

source.quote: At the end of the Second World War, Canada had the third-largest navy in the world.

verification.evidence: At the end of the Second World War, Canada had the third-largest navy in the world.

text.en: Japan surrendered on August 14, 1945. That ended four years of war in the Pacific.
text.fr: Le Japon a capitulé le 14 août 1945. Cela a mis fin à quatre ans de guerre dans le Pacifique.

source.quote: Japan surrendered on August 14, 1945—the end of four years of war in the Pacific.

verification.evidence: Japan surrendered on August 14, 1945—the end of four years of war in the Pacific.

text.en: In 1988, the Government of Canada apologized for the wrongs done to Canadians of Japanese origin during the war, and it paid compensation to the victims.
text.fr: En 1988, le gouvernement du Canada a présenté des excuses pour les torts causés aux Canadiens d'origine japonaise pendant la guerre et a indemnisé les victimes.

source.quote: The Government of Canada apologized in 1988 for wartime wrongs and compensated the victims.

verification.evidence: Regrettably, the state of war and public opinion in B.C. led to the forcible relocation of Canadians of Japanese origin by the federal government and the sale of their property without compensation. This occurred even though the military and the RCMP told Ottawa that they posed little danger to Canada. The Government of Canada apologized in 1988 for wartime wrongs and compensated the victims.
